voice.ashen_requiem.waking.done: Cold. My legs still work. That's a start.
voice.ashen_requiem.scrap.open: Rubble everywhere. Somebody built things here once. Some of it must still be useful.
voice.ashen_requiem.scrap_knife.open: That sharp piece of scrap could cut, with a handle on it.
voice.ashen_requiem.clean_wood.open: My fingers itch where I touched that bark. Better peel it off before I carry any.
voice.ashen_requiem.clean_wood.done: Pale wood underneath. That feels safe to hold.
voice.ashen_requiem.old_workbench.open: The bench in the corner is missing a leg and half its top. I can fix that.
voice.ashen_requiem.old_workbench.done: It stands. The first thing here that works.
voice.ashen_requiem.dead_planks.open: With a working bench I can saw these logs into boards.
voice.ashen_requiem.own_bench.open: If I'm going anywhere, I'll need a bench that goes with me.
voice.ashen_requiem.wooden_pickaxe.open: Rock is too hard for bare hands. Wood first, then something better.
voice.ashen_requiem.wooden_pickaxe.done: It won't last, but it'll bite.
voice.ashen_requiem.ashen_stone.open: This pick won't last long. The rock it breaks could make a better one.
voice.ashen_requiem.ashen_stone.done: Stone in my hands. Now I can go somewhere.
